query:
INSERT INTO accounts
                         (name, type, role, has_transactions, closed, sort_order, external_account_id,
                          created_by_batch_id)
                       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), -1) + 1 FROM accounts), ?, ?)
                       RETURNING id AS "id!: i64"
